Confirms: "Puck recovery is key", "D must support each other and communicate", "Read puck possession quality when supporting your D partner", "Protect the ice between dots; pivot to the middle". Directly supports this scenario's claim that the nearest player retrieves a loose puck while the other defender covers the slot/protects the middle, and that assignments update once possession changes. Does not specify or endorse any exact coordinate, distance or guaranteed outcome; those remain original synthesis as the catalog entry discloses.
